info.name: Get a list of visits and submissions given a client id.

params.name: start_at
params.description: Filter by start date greater or equal than specified value

params.name: end_at
params.description: Filter by end date less or equal than specified value. If not specified, the default date will be defaulted to the end of today's date

params.name: page
params.description: Filter by page number. If not specified will default to 1

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items per page. If not specified will default to 100

items.docs:

  - `ACL_PATROL_CLIENT_REPORTS_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_SHIFTREPORT_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_REPORTS_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_REPORTS_HISTORICAL_VIEW`
* `client_id` and `external_client_id` are mutually exclusive
* `employee_id` and `external_employee_id` are mutually exclusive

info.name: Get a list of cancel codes

params.description: Filter by branch ID `(default: current user branch)`

items.docs: Get a list of cancel codes

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter on a list of tags and return values for at least one matching tag. Filter by multiple tag names using **OR**.

params.name: start_date_from
params.description:
Filter by visit start date time greater or equal than specified value.
If not specified will default to now.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
`start_at` can be used as this filter name
Ex: `2018-02-03T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: start_date_to
params.description:
Filter by visit start date time less than or equal than specified value.
If not specified will default to 7 days from now.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
`end_at` can be used as this filter name
Ex: `2019-02-18T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: end_date_from
params.description:
Filter by visit end date time greater or equal than specified value.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
Ex: `2019-02-03T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: end_date_to
params.description:
Filter by visit end date time less than or equal than specified value.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
Ex: `2018-02-18T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: is_cancelled
params.description:
If true, returns only visits with a valid cancel code, not including 'On Hold'.
If false, returns only visits with 'On Hold' codes or *no* cancel code.

params.name: is_on_hold
params.description:
If true, returns only visits with an 'On Hold' cancel code.
If false, returns only visits with *no* cancel code or with a cancel code other than 'On Hold'.

params.name: is_vacant
params.description:
If true, returns only visits with *no* employee assigned.
If false, returns only visits with an employee assigned.

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the visit based on status hierarchy from AlayaCare web application, one or more using **OR**.

params.description: Filter by branch ID `(default: current user branch)`

params.name: employee_id
params.description:
Filter by external employee ID
External employee ID is the employee ID in the system of record.
Ex. HR employee number

If the visit belongs to a facility, this endpoint will return a `404`. Use `GET /facility_visits/{alayacare_visit_id}` instead.
